status: Assumed data-generating processes for a demonstration. NOT World Bank findings. Coefficients fixed before any classifier was fitted and never tuned on model results.

common.noise: Bernoulli draw from p = sigmoid(logit); intercept b0 solved numerically so mean(p) over the population equals the target prevalence
common.random_effects: project effect u_p ~ N(0, sigma_project^2) and country effect v_c ~ N(0, sigma_country^2), drawn per project / country with the scenario seed; stored only in generator internals
common.standardisation_constants: means / SDs of numeric drivers computed on the full in-window population and recorded in provenance (part of the simulated world, not a fitted model)
common.driver_policy: drivers are a subset of the inventory `include` features available at the prediction point; no amounts, JV / supplier fields, governance or macro values, re-bid markers or post-event data

m2_amendment.prevalence_basis: ASSUMED. Only public floor: 0.03% of contracts carry amendment wording (not a rate).

S0.description: null: labels independent of every feature; no random effects

S1.description: linear-additive main effects + moderate project effect

S2.description: S1 main effects + predefined non-linearity and interaction + project and country effects

m3_rebid.unit: tender at first publication (de-duplicated DS00979 IFB / REOI / prequalification notice)
m3_rebid.prevalence_basis: ASSUMED. Only public floor: 0.4% of tender notices carry explicit re-bid wording (not a rate).

S0.description: null: labels independent of every feature; no random effects

S1.description: linear-additive main effects + moderate project effect

S2.description: S1 main effects + predefined non-linearity and interaction + project and country effects
